Do I Need Garbage Disposal Repair?

The average lifespan for a garbage disposal is 8-10 years. If your unit is older, you should expect to need more regular garbage disposal repair service. But, if you need repairs too frequently, that’s a big sign that it’s time for a new garbage disposal replacement. If you find that your family runs through garbage disposals more quickly than average, you might want to think about upgrade options, as your kitchen waste capacity may be exceeding what your current disposal can handle.

Garbage disposals come with various blades, motors, and power levels. If you opt for a larger, more powerful unit with stainless steel blades, you’re more likely to have a working unit for longer. Before your unit stops working, there are often signs that it’s struggling. If you notice any changes in performance, it’s a good idea to have a professional plumber take a look to avoid dirty water backed up into your sink and other issues.
